_readme: Commits whose result-determining code a human has verified to be equivalent.
The aggregator pools runs across commits only when they are in the same class
here; anything not listed keeps its own identity and is refused as before.
Every entry states what the diff actually is, so the claim can be re-checked
with `git diff <ref> <sha> -- src scripts configs pyproject.toml`.
tests/test_aggregation_guard.py pins that undeclared commits are still refused
and that every commit listed here exists in this repository.

classes.reason: The re-run batches after the two training fixes. Their diff against the reference touches only: the `random` model branch (configs/random*.yaml, src/models/random_model.py, the `random` case in the factory and trainer encode-fn), provenance and git-state recording (src/utils/provenance.py, scripts/train.py), an evaluator docstring, and the queue runner's skip guard. None of these can change a non-Random model's training or ranking; the main matrix (cc06c20) was re-run with three seeds and reproduces the ordering it was re-run for.
